sources.label: Morphe patches: AML mod loader and PC mod ports for GTA: San Andreas - Definitiv
sources.author: GTA SA DE Mods (RAZORRZR0)
patch_list: CLEO Android 2.0.1: runs CLEO scripts with the swipe-down CLEO menu, script text and touch. Installs its 14 GTA SA scripts in Android/data/com.rockstargames.gtasa.de/cleo/ (the .csa ones, such as invincibility and regeneration, always run:…
Restores map props missing from the Definitive Edition.
Plays one of the game's eight loading-screen themes (S_000-S_007) while a save loads, like the PC SALoadingMusic mod.
In-game settings menu for the other mods.

Loads Unreal .pak mod files from Android/data/com.rockstargames.gtasa.de/paks/ when the game starts. They load above the game's own paks, so any file a mod pak contains replaces the game's copy (PC Definitive Edition pak mods work as-is).…
Project Props 4: about 16,000 extra map props. Downloads the Project Props placements from github.com/user-grinch/Project-Props while patching (needs internet).
PS2-style graphics: PS2 timecyc, radiosity, distant lamp coronas, post effects.
